About the bakery

A Victorian bakery, run by a local family

Harbour Street Bakery is a family-owned artisan bakery run by Kristy and Blair Gourdie, in the old Harbour Board Building on Harbour Street — right in the heart of Oamaru’s Victorian Precinct.

All ingredients and flour are locally and organically sourced, and everything is baked on stone and fresh daily. You’ll also find their wares at the Oamaru Farmers Market every Sunday.

Find us at the Oamaru Farmers Market — every Sunday, alongside the shop at 4 Harbour Street.
